pulse.text: **Artificial Analysis's v4.1.1 patch has landed on the leaderboard** - upgraded graders (GPT-5.6 Luna, medium) and a refreshed tau-cubed-Banking dataset re-score **Claude Opus 5 to 63 at max effort, up from 61**, with Anthropic still sole #1 and Fable 5 second at 62; GPT-5.6 Sol moves to 61 and Kimi K3 to 60 on the same pass. Nothing has shipped since Grok Imagine Image 2.0 on Aug 7 and x.ai's docs still top out at grok-4.5, but Kalshi now prices **Grok 4.6 at 90% before Aug 15**, up from 88%. The strangest move is Gemini: CNBC reported Alphabet slid a second day on word that Google is months behind on its next model, yet **Kalshi's Gemini 3.5 Pro Aug 31 leg firmed to 57% from 53%** and Polymarket holds 59%. OpenAI's Astra gave back this morning's recovery, **81% by Sep 30 on Polymarket from 85%**, while Kalshi's before-Oct-1 leg stayed flat at 73%. New on the board: Kalshi has listed a next-Mythos-class release market reading 66% before Oct 1, slightly ahead of Polymarket's 63% - and the week of Aug 10 still holds Qwen3.8-Max's open weights and Grok 4.6's own deadline.
